pr.title: Add order search and offset paging
pr.description:
Adds `GET /orders/search` with a text filter on the customer name, a status filter, a date range, a minimum total, and a sort column and direction.

`GET /orders` now takes `offset` and `limit` instead of `page`. The new web client in this release asks for the rows after the ones it shows. `listOrders` takes a row offset to match.

bugs.note: Injection: the sort direction comes from the query string and goes into ORDER BY without an allowlist.
Missed caller: listOrders now takes a row offset, but the unchanged daily report still passes page numbers 1, 2, 3, so it skips the first row and counts each order many times.

traps.why: The status values go into the SQL text, but the filter keeps only the fixed ORDER_STATUSES values.
GET /orders drops the page parameter. The PR text names the change and the client that uses the new parameters.

extras.note: A sort value such as constructor reads an Object.prototype member, so the ORDER BY text breaks and the search answers 500.
An impossible date such as 2026-02-30 passes the pattern. The database rejects it, and the search answers 500, not 400.
